abstract: A 43-year-old male visited our hospital with complaints of right scrotal swelling and lower abdominal mass. Computed tomographic (CT) scan showed the right testicular tumor and regional enlarged lymph nodes. However, there were no metastasis in lung, brain, liver, and bone. First, we performed chemotherapy of modified PVB regimen (cisplatinum, vinblastine, peplomycin) prior to the right orchiectomy, because a tumor lump was palpable from the right testis to the lower abdominal mass. After three courses of modified PVB chemotherapy, beta-HCG, HCG and LDH values became within normal limits and all tumors were necrotic on the CT scan. Then, we performed the right orchiectomy and retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy simultaneously. After operation, two courses of VIP chemotherapy (etoposide, ifosfamide, cisplatinum) were performed since viable cells in one of the obturator lymph nodes were pathologically noticed. The patient has been free of recurrence of the tumor for 15 months after the treatment. In the particular case, in which the primary testicular tumor was not extirpated en bloc, the initial chemotherapy followed by orchiectomy was found to be feasible.
abstract_ja: 43歳の男性が、右陰嚢の腫脹と下腹部腫瘤を主訴に当院を受診した。CTで右精巣腫瘍と領域リンパ節腫大が認められた。一方、肺、脳、肝臓、骨には転移はなかった。精巣から下腹部腫瘤まで腫瘍塊が触知されたため、右精巣摘除術に先立ち、修正PVB療法（シスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、ペプロマイシン）を施行した。修正PVB療法3コース後、β-hCG、hCG、LDHは正常範囲内となり、CTでは全病変が壊死を示した。その後、右精巣摘除術と後腹膜リンパ節郭清を同時に施行した。術後、閉鎖リンパ節の1つに生存細胞が病理学的に認められたため、VIP療法（エトポシド、イホスファミド、シスプラチン）を2コース施行した。治療後15か月間、腫瘍の再発はない。原発精巣腫瘍をen blocに摘出しなかった本症例では、初回化学療法後の精巣摘除術が実施可能であることが明らかとなった。
